server.name: community-cyanheads-git
server.note: A community git server with 28 tools, deliberately audited with the same fixtures as the reference git server: same backend semantics, two implementations. It declares readOnlyHint on all 28 tools and idempotentHint on none. The registry entry describes a bun run script (bun run start:stdio); those arguments are passed through here because that is what the registry says, and the published bin ignores them.

fixtures.note: the same fixture as the reference git server's commit_staged, so the two implementations can be compared directly
stages an untracked file, and takes a list, so F5 applies
one tool with a mode argument covering create, delete and rename: a repeat should find the branch already there
